bullets.text: AI-RAN Testing Takes Centre Stage - **Keysight** and **Samsung** unveil unified AI-RAN testing workflows at MWC.
AI Inference Demands New Fabrics - **Arrcus** highlights the need for intelligent, policy-aware network fabrics for edge AI workloads.
Turkcell Partners with Huawei - **Turkcell** and **Huawei** strengthen ties to advance AI and 5G technologies.
1 Billion Scam Calls Flagged - **VMO2**'s AI successfully identifies over 1 billion suspected scam calls for **O2** customers.
Qualcomm's 6G Vision Revealed - **Qualcomm** outlines three foundational pillars for future 6G networks at MWC.
Telcos Struggle with Enterprise Expectations - A **Capgemini** report reveals gaps in telecoms meeting enterprise needs.
Military 5G as a Blueprint - Military deployments provide insights for resilient private networks in enterprises.
Huawei's AI-Centric Solutions Launched - **Huawei** unveils AI-driven network solutions to prepare for the agentic era.
AI Era Reshapes Telecom Economics - **Jio** CEO discusses how AI will redefine telecom networks and economic models.
AI Enhances Cloud RAN Efficiency - A trial shows how AI can improve network efficiency in **Cloud RAN** environments.
